directoryStructure.description: Visual tree representation of the repository.

instruction.description: Optional context or AI instructions for the repository.

fileSummary.description: An optional summary of the files included in this snapshot.

userProvidedHeader.description: An optional custom header provided by the user.

files.description: Map of file paths to their full source code.

sources.description: Web pages scraped into this snapshot (see `jref scrape` / `jref pack --scrape`). Content is stored as cleaned Markdown + HTML; html_document is regenerable and raw HTML is opt-in.

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was scraped.

dynamic.description: Whether the page was rendered with a headless browser (Playwright).

depth.description: Crawl depth of this page (0 = seed URL).

parentUrl.description: URL of the page that linked to this one during a crawl, or null for seed URLs.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code when known; null when the engine does not report one (the scraper throws on non-OK responses, so a stored page was fetched successfully).

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the stored Markdown content.

metadata.description: Page metadata extracted from JSON-LD, OpenGraph, and standard meta tags.

markdown.description: Main content converted to GitHub Flavored Markdown.

rawHtml.description: Full raw HTML as fetched (only stored with --include-raw-html).

navLinks.description: Same-domain links found in nav/aside elements.

internalLinks.description: Same-domain links found anywhere in the page.

error.description: Fetch/convert error for this page; set only when markdown/html are empty (a failed page in a crawl).
